LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANTS YERIS PAREDES AND RENE ZUNIGA'S MOTION TO SET ASIDE DEFAULT IS DENIED. DEFENDANTS HAVE NOT SHOWN THAT THEIR FAILURE TO RESPOND TO THE SUMMONS AND COMPLAINT WAS THE RESULT OF SURPRISE MISTAKE OR EXCUSABLE NEGLECT, AND BECAUSE DEFENDANT HAS FAILED TO ATTACH A PROPOSED RESPONSIVE PLEADING. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: SONIA WONG, CSR #11288
